title: Inventory the supplied telecom workflow and save workshop capability evidence
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Authenticated AWS Workshop Studio and provided ServiceNow/telecom environment only; actual resource names, account/region and permissions must be read from the event guide.
steps: Record customer, IT and network agent locations; digital-twin/tools; subject-agent model route; scenario switch; guardrails; telemetry and storage.
Record gateway A, gateway B and shared model gateway as separate roles; identify their actual products/interfaces without substituting AgentCore Gateway by name.
Create a source-cited capability sheet including identifiers, readable sources, accepted test scenarios and mutable hooks; exclude credentials.
Record displayed event dates and environment duration as separate facts; a72-hour environment duration does not establish a submission deadline.
done_when: Each of the 12 supplied-system components has an observed location or explicit unavailable/unknown entry.
Account, region, resource scope and approved workflow entry are documented with dates.
No feature is marked verified solely because it appears on the architecture diagram.
risk: Workshop guide and authenticated account were not inspected when this backlog was drafted; live walkthrough must await access.

title: Select permitted compute and record capability checks
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Reuse permitted workshop runtime/worker first; Lambda, containers, scheduling and AgentCore are alternatives only if the guide and permissions confirm them.
steps: Identify supported package installation, inbound hooks, outbound model/source access, background execution and filesystem/state limits.
Choose one minimal runtime for worker/investigator; record local-only fallbacks and effects on live claims.
Give each unverified capability an owner, test, consequence and current state.
done_when: One deployment target is justified by workshop evidence, or live work is explicitly blocked.
Every required route has a permitted hosting/reachability plan.
Capability entries distinguish proposed, documented, exercised and unavailable.
risk: Choosing unpermitted compute can consume the hackathon without producing an accepted integration.

title: Bind team identities and configure scoped access
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Workshop-issued IAM/session and ServiceNow authorization; existing credential mechanisms only, no new identity service by default.
steps: Load credentials through permitted configuration without committing or copying secret values into evidence.
Bind trusted team, point and source-instance context outside model/caller text.
Check allowed and denied team/source/record access and safe credential expiry handling.
done_when: A permitted read succeeds and an unauthorized scoped access is denied without leaking record existence.
Credentials are absent from source, logs and exported fixtures.
Team prefixes are treated as names, not proof of tenant isolation.
risk: Shared workshop accounts can appear isolated while readers, caches or exports remain overbroad.

title: Prove ServiceNow AICT assets and permitted finding/response capabilities
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Provided ServiceNow AI Control Tower connection and permitted workflow APIs/UI; exact tables, endpoints and rights remain unverified.
steps: Use the provided signed-in ServiceNow account for read-only capability discovery immediately; configured application credentials and integration permission tests follow T03. Do not wait for the compute decision to read the guide or inspect supplied assets.
Read actual team connection/assets and map all supplied agents.
Separately test permitted trace/run read access, finding route, recipient resolution, response readback and correction/update semantics.
Record exact route/schema/version behavior and any organizer-approved alternative; do not infer write rights from asset discovery.
done_when: Asset readback is saved with target instance and team scope.
Finding, owner, response and trace capabilities each have independent observed evidence or a blocking gap.
Mandatory ServiceNow/human-loop scope has a feasible verified route or an explicit organizer dependency.
risk: Inventory-only AICT participation does not establish alert delivery or the required human loop.

title: Prove the approved fast Nemotron endpoint with a minimal call
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Actual workshop-approved NVIDIA Nemotron route; Lightning is only a preferred label until exact endpoint/model is verified. No substitution with an unrelated public endpoint.
steps: Resolve the approved endpoint, exact model identity/configuration and allowed hosting/data route.
Run a minimal authorized request; test response format, usage, provider request identity and enforceable output limits.
Record unknown provider fields honestly and choose the smallest working extraction profile.
done_when: A real approved response and request provenance are available without exposing secrets.
Structured output behavior and failure/timeout behavior are measured on the actual route.
Endpoint access gaps block model completion claims; a model badge is insufficient.
risk: Public NVIDIA documentation cannot prove workshop model entitlement or actual execution.

title: Create one shared package and versioned configuration
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: One Python distribution with worker/query entry points; framework and exact supported version selected after T02, without new microservices.
steps: Create modules for contracts, policy, sources, controls, validation, governance, query and scenarios.
Pin dependencies and schema/evaluator/prompt/model-profile versions in configuration.
Provide local development and package commands; retain revision history.
done_when: A clean checkout installs and invokes package help.
Runtime reports exact package and configuration versions.
Tests and fixtures use the same shared contracts as eventual adapters.
risk: Separate ad hoc notebooks/scripts can silently diverge on IDs, thresholds and arithmetic.

title: Define canonical schemas and retry identities
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Typed Python records and JSON/JSONL using the workshop-compatible validation library; no schema registry service required.
steps: Define run, action, attempt, observation, execution, usage, obligation, assessment and finding records.
Separate transport duplicates from new actual executions; encode attempt-to-execution cardinality as zero, one or many.
Declare provenance classes and source-scoped identifiers; reject changed payload reuse under an immutable request identity.
done_when: Fixtures cover duplicate delivery, hidden retries and execution IDs reused across source namespaces.
Every persisted type has schema version, team and provenance fields.
Actual executions cannot be erased by deduplicating only on attempt ID.
risk: Conflating an attempted call, actual provider execution and observation undercounts usage.

title: Implement authoritative lifecycle and execution correlation
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Shared state repository through a small adapter; conditional updates if workshop permits concurrent live transitions.
steps: Implement OPEN, ACTIONS_CLOSED and EVIDENCE_FINAL as separate transitions.
Map scoped source/provider identifiers to runs and attempts; preserve unmatched and conflicting assignments.
Record closure, expected sources, late-data cutoffs and correction lineage; do not let callers reset budget by choosing new IDs.
done_when: Closing actions does not discard late usage or imply source finality.
A provider execution claimed by two runs is retained as a conflict, not charged twice.
Evidence finalization records either satisfied completion rules or explicit gaps.
risk: Local lifecycle state does not prove upstream dispatch stopped without an actual supported hook.

title: Freeze dated thresholds, measurement definitions and owners
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Versioned configuration and immutable policy records in the approved repository; JSON/YAML acceptable if reproducible.
steps: Declare C7 event/timing scope, C9 accepted labels/baseline/windows and C16 accounting/population.
Record exact comparison boundaries, allowed exception counts/shares, rationale, owners and required evidence coverage.
Freeze the first bundle before scored runs; preserve original versions and dates.
done_when: A reviewer can identify metric, denominator, threshold, allowance, source authority and owner for each claimed control.
Baseline and assessed scenarios are separated before evaluation.
Policies are dated and justified rather than inferred from observed results.
risk: Choosing thresholds or denominators after seeing outcomes invalidates pass/breach demonstrations.

title: Load pinned policy and explicit action-to-control mappings
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Shared policy loader and cached immutable bundle; register reads stay outside each inference request.
steps: Map declared actions/points/windows to applicable controls and responsibilities.
Pin the validated bundle at run/window creation; reject caller-selected weaker versions.
Separate selection expiry, active continuation deadline, hard cutoff, revocation and historical replay.
done_when: Unmatched in-scope actions appear as mapping gaps.
Historical assessments load their original exact rule after later policy changes.
Updating a bundle cannot reset an existing run's spend or silently replace a frozen C9 baseline.
risk: A single expiry timestamp used for all purposes can incorrectly stop valid work or rewrite historical results.

title: Implement raw and canonical repositories with a portable local path
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: S3/DynamoDB only if allowed; otherwise an approved existing store through the same contracts. SQLite is suitable for local/offline indexing, not a substitute for distributed admission state.
steps: Preserve immutable captured raw versions and resolvable references.
Store canonical records and gaps with stable keys/version checks.
Implement repository interfaces and a local fixture backend; decide the permitted live backend from T02.
done_when: A raw capture and corresponding canonical record survive restart and remain addressable by version.
Malformed/unmatched inputs can be retained without fabricating valid facts.
Repository choice and concurrency guarantees are documented.
risk: Mutable overwrite or unversioned references make prior answers impossible to reproduce.

title: Read and preserve gateway/telemetry sources safely
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Existing gateway/OTEL/CloudWatch or other workshop telemetry reader, only where actually exposed; no additional event bus.
steps: Implement scoped paginated pull with declared cursor semantics, filters and truncation handling.
Preserve recoverable raw pages before acknowledging durable receipt or advancing checkpoint.
Expose failed pages, expired cursors, unsupported schemas and uncertain completion.
done_when: Crash after preservation before checkpoint replays without data loss.
Partial fetch is reported as partial rather than an empty successful result.
Source namespace, capture version, filters and collection status accompany evidence.
risk: Reading all available pages does not establish upstream completeness.

title: Read ServiceNow evidence and preserve generated provenance
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Verified permitted ServiceNow evidence route; exact API/table and paging semantics must come from workshop access.
steps: Capture authorized incident/notes/traces and delivery/response records with source versions or explicit local capture IDs.
Preserve authorship and whether text was generated by our investigator/governance flow.
Apply field-level redaction and source-scope permission checks before model context/export.
done_when: A real permitted record is retrievable by stable captured reference.
Generated notes are not treated as independent corroboration.
Missing read permission remains a visible response/evidence gap.
risk: ServiceNow text can contain ambiguous identities or prompt injection, and is not automatically authoritative usage.

title: Build independent expected-work and source-authority manifests
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Accepted organizer/orchestrator/run-ledger sources where available; explicit scoped fixture authorities for authorized tests.
steps: Identify authorities for intended work, event slots, actual executions, usage and diagnostic labels separately.
Record expected events/pairs, sources, windows and eligible runs independently of surviving telemetry.
Preserve uncertainty when the platform cannot expose a required population.
done_when: Removing an observed event does not remove its independent expected obligation.
A wholly missing stream/window can be represented and queried.
No control claims a complete population solely from what was collected.
risk: Unavailable independent populations may block completion of an affected control scope.

title: Parse and reconcile duplicates, conflicts, corrections and freshness
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Deterministic Python parsers and repository transactions/conditional revisions as permitted.
steps: Normalize structured fields, units, clocks and cumulative/incremental usage semantics.
Deduplicate identical observations while retaining changed-content conflicts and authoritative correction history.
Track per-source freshness, required coverage and unresolved identity/accounting gaps.
done_when: A corrected total replaces the accepted previous total instead of adding to it.
Duplicate observations do not multiply an execution charge.
Collection lag, missing source, unusable field and conflicting authority remain separate states.
risk: Incorrect cumulative counter semantics can produce plausible but false cost totals.

title: Store evidence bindings, model proposals and versioned cases
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Existing approved repositories; versioned tables/collections in the shared package, no graph database required.
steps: Represent many-to-many fact/control/spec/scope bindings with exact record revisions.
Store candidate model assertions separately from accepted facts.
Persist assessment and case manifests only with resolvable required inputs or explicit gaps.
done_when: One usage fact supports multiple controls without multiplying accounting rows.
Candidate extraction cannot enter authoritative calculations before validation.
Partial writes remain pending; published cases reference coherent durable versions.
risk: Fan-out joins and silent proposal promotion corrupt both arithmetic and explainability.

title: Build exact-scope retrieval and bounded narrative context selection
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Exact indexes in the approved store plus optional local SQLite; simple lexical/context ranking first, embeddings only if justified and allowed.
steps: Retrieve complete available obligations, records, unmatched inputs and gaps for a pinned scope.
Expose index lag, page limits and unavailable references.
Rank narrative excerpts for context without using top-k retrieval as the control denominator.
done_when: A scope lookup returns explicit coverage metadata with the requested revision.
Records without an existing control binding remain discoverable.
Context truncation is disclosed independently of structured-evidence completeness.
risk: Semantic retrieval can omit decisive records if reused as the evidence population.

title: Connect the minimum supported gateway/handoff observation adapters
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Permitted shared-model-gateway and gateway A hooks or read-only sources; blocking ability remains conditional.
steps: Translate supported request/outcome/handoff payloads into canonical events and identities.
Implement emit with explicit durable versus best-effort acknowledgement.
Capture one actual end-to-end subject run using the selected supported integration; label observation-only boundaries honestly.
done_when: An actual run connects at least the selected supported boundaries to canonical evidence.
Adapter metadata states what it can observe and what it can prevent.
Unsupported hooks do not lead to invented synchronous enforcement claims.
risk: Platform access may expose only telemetry, requiring narrower monitoring claims.

title: Implement C16 whole-run actual token accounting first
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Pure Python evaluator over accepted provider/gateway usage; reuse existing repository and query contracts.
steps: Reconcile all governed executions across three agents and hidden retries.
Apply non-overlapping input/output/cache/reasoning accounting and sum once per execution.
Evaluate inclusive cap and interval exceptions; distinguish definitive breach from insufficient under-cap evidence.
done_when: Complete 9600 versus cap10000 satisfies; complete10800 breaches by800 in labelled illustrative fixtures.
An accepted scoped subtotal above cap still proves breach despite unrelated gaps.
Missing usage or unresolved executions prevent a final under-cap pass; reservations never count as actual usage.
risk: Provider usage may omit hidden retries or finality, blocking reliable under-cap satisfaction.

title: Validate extraction schemas, spans, scope and authority
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Host-side typed validators over captured sources; no second LLM as truth authority.
steps: Check exact source/span/version and normalization mappings for each proposal.
Reauthorize both ends of every relation and validate permitted scope/type.
Separate VERIFIED source quote, verified relation and operational fact; require declared authority/corroboration for the precise assertion.
done_when: A valid quote with wrong meaning or negation cannot support an operational claim.
Similar incident names and forged IDs cannot create verified cross-run/team links.
REJECTED proposal means failed validation, not proof the underlying world claim is false.
risk: Exact text occurrence alone cannot establish entailment or source truth.

title: Manage accepted revisions and invalidate affected assessments
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Conditional accepted-input revision publication in the approved state store; local fixture equivalent for tests.
steps: Promote validated candidates atomically against their base revision; revalidate conflicts.
Track dependencies from inputs to runs/windows/populations/claims/caches and recompute only affected branches.
Preserve historical assertions and explicit baseline restatements; distinguish authority changes from access revocation.
done_when: Concurrent corrections cannot publish mixed old/new accepted facts.
A parser/link correction can invalidate cases even when raw bytes are unchanged.
Frozen baseline corrections retain the original dated basis and explicit restatement.
risk: Stale cache or partial dependency invalidation can present an invalid proof as current.

title: Implement C7 event coverage and valid timing-pair evaluation
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Pure Python evaluator over independent obligations and accepted event records.
steps: Match expected events and build expected adjacent pairs from authoritative slots/order.
Check clock domain/epoch, precision and monotonicity before timing arithmetic.
Apply exact gaps and exception allowance; distinguish proven omission from collection lag and empty/unknown populations.
done_when: An omitted middle event preserves both expected pairs instead of creating a shortcut pair.
The slide fixture with 11 events and ten gaps has one violation and10% share under the declared comparison.
Unmeasurable clocks or missing populations do not silently produce a pass.
risk: Cross-agent timestamps may not share an eligible clock, restricting meaningful timing assertions.

title: Establish C9 labels, scoring and frozen positive baseline
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Organizer-accepted scenario labels and deterministic exact-match scorer; no model grading its own answers.
steps: Freeze accepted labels, aliases, eligible cohort and baseline/evaluation split.
Map each canonical outcome once; score evidence-proven wrong/crash as zero and missing/unparseable evidence as unknown.
Compute a complete positive baseline with all required eligible outcomes.
done_when: Scenario-switch availability is not treated as proof of ground-truth labels.
Baseline membership and scoring rules precede assessed cases.
Invalid/incomplete/zero baseline blocks relative-drop claims rather than dividing or substituting silently.
risk: Without accepted labels and comparable outcomes, C9 cannot be completed by plausible model narration.

title: Implement C9 windows, comparability, drift and exception population
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Shared scheduler/worker only if permitted; otherwise declared batch window closure over accepted run manifests.
steps: Register expected windows and exact members before assessment.
Check dataset/cohort/model/prompt/tool and measurement compatibility.
Calculate relative drops before rounding and evaluate expected-window coverage and interval allowance separately.
done_when: B=.900, M=.792 produces12% relative drop; M=.810 is exactly10% and follows the declared inclusive boundary.
Missing windows remain in the expected population.
An allowed violating-window share does not suppress an individual threshold-crossing alert obligation.
risk: Mixing incompatible cohorts can produce misleading apparent drift.

title: Create C16 findings first, then extend deterministic C9 alert intents
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Actual permitted ServiceNow workflow mapped through one governance adapter; no assumed table/API.
steps: Start the shared permitted finding route with a measured C16 breach so actual governance delivery can be proved before C9 is complete. Extend the same mechanism to required C9 crossings after T24.
Create one stable required intent for every measured crossing, bound to control/spec/window/assessment and named authoritative recipient.
Assign immutable operation mutation revisions to exact payload, target, routing, recipient and content; duplicates reuse the same cause.
Allow validated cited explanation enrichment without making required alerts depend on Nemotron.
done_when: The first C16 finding is independently ready for delivery; completion of the later C9 milestone is tracked separately and required before claiming C9 complete.
Repeated recomputation does not spam duplicate intents.
Owner/content change without assessment change creates a distinct operation revision.
Model text cannot authorize sending, select the recipient or alter the measured verdict.
risk: Idempotency keyed only by assessment revision can lose later route/content changes.

title: Deliver findings with bounded retries and verified remote readback
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Verified ServiceNow receiver semantics with durable local outbox; remote idempotency/version checks only if actually supported.
steps: Persist intent/outbox consistently or recover via explicit durable sweep.
Check intent validity/supersession before conditional dispatch claim; reconcile uncertain writes without blind repeated creates.
Read back target instance, correlation, intended mutation revision/content and named-recipient route; bound attempts and expose terminal gaps.
done_when: Lost acknowledgement becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until reconciled.
Remote ID or HTTP202 alone cannot mark intended content/recipient delivered.
Stale updates cannot silently overwrite accepted corrections; unsupported safe remote ordering remains unresolved.
risk: Local deduplication or eventual empty lookup does not provide exactly-once remote creation.

title: Track human response, remediation and passing retests honestly
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Permitted ServiceNow actor/assignment/response and remediation records; workshop response coverage dictates supported states.
steps: Retain recipient-at-delivery, reassignment and authoritative actor/action history.
Record actual acknowledgement/response or covered no-response as-of; distinguish missing visibility from silence.
Link authorized remediation closure to relevant passing retest; distinguish correction/withdrawal from remediation.
done_when: Human reply is not made a hackathon completion prerequisite.
Performance BREACHED, alert DELIVERED, no response observed and remediation OPEN can coexist.
New passing run or policy version does not erase the original failure.
risk: Auto-generated notes or assignment changes can be mistaken for actual human action.

title: Build the first Nemotron evidence-extraction prompt and fixtures
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: One approved fast Nemotron model through T05; one-call extraction plus host template is the initial profile.
steps: Request typed candidates, exact quotations/references, proposed links and explicit ambiguity.
Prepare note/usage contradiction, similar-ticket and prompt-injection fixtures with human-labelled expected support.
Use real captured source input for the first live extraction, preserving its provenance.
done_when: Output validates against the host schema and links back to exact captures.
Unsupported links remain candidates rather than entering accepted facts.
The first usable vertical slice has a real approved model invocation, not just a stored prompt.
risk: More elaborate prompting cannot repair missing authoritative sources.

title: Add bounded corroboration and optional second-call composition
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: One approved Nemotron endpoint and host read tools; second composition call is within the same bounded core workflow, not a separate service.
steps: Start with extraction plus deterministic rendering; add a second call only if composition of validated facts adds measured value.
Permit one bounded corroborating-read batch; validate/promote and recompute before composition.
Pass only final assessments, validated facts and labelled candidates to a constrained explanation-plan composer with no more tools or extraction.
done_when: At most two model calls and six model-requested read invocations including pages occur per declared profile.
No hidden third call interprets newly retrieved prose.
All numeric verdicts and exact quotations are rendered from host-validated inputs.
risk: Agent loops and implicit SDK retries can break the deadline and make costs unpredictable.

title: Record assurance usage and enforce non-recursion/resource limits
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Shared trace/usage repository and host-enforced wall-time/tool/token/concurrency limits; provider limits verified on actual route.
steps: Record every model/tool attempt, provider identity, versions, usage, timings and uncertain outcome.
Declare subject versus assurance accounting scope; report subtotals and combined spend.
Stop automatic self-investigation; reconcile later included investigator usage in a deterministic later assessment.
done_when: Timeouts/ambiguous calls retain potential cost instead of becoming zero.
An immutable case does not claim finality over its own still-running composition usage.
Budget exhaustion/closed-run rules cannot be bypassed to investigate a denied action.
risk: Self-accounting can recurse or undercount unless as-of cutoffs and policy inclusion are explicit.

title: Compose coherent control states and the C-FM-01 claim
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Deterministic composer and constrained templates in the shared package.
steps: Keep requirement verdict, safeguard operation, evidence sufficiency, analysis completion and control completion distinct.
Combine compatible required objective-level branches after their allowances, preserving exact run/window scope.
Validate explanation references/manifests and exclude known-invalid current proof.
done_when: Any valid required branch breach makes the claim BREACHED even with other gaps.
No breach plus unknown/incompatible required branch yields NOT_ESTABLISHED, not SATISFIED.
Unavailable C7/C9 branches remain explicitly missing during the initial C16/model slice.
risk: Averaging child statuses or combining different snapshots can produce false all-green claims.

title: Implement explicit judge query profiles and scope resolution
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Local CLI first; optional small UI later over the same result contract. No public hosting required.
steps: Accept explicit control/run/window/profile and a stable client query key before dispatch.
Distinguish fresh investigation, recorded-case inspection and offline recheck.
Resolve all applicable C9 windows/member runs and pin event interval, source vector and accepted-input revision.
done_when: Ambiguous scope returns NEEDS_SCOPE without selecting the easiest subset.
Changed payload under an existing query identity is a conflict.
Recorded/cached analysis is labelled with its original model execution.
risk: Run-only selectors can omit multi-run window evidence and change the meaning of C9.

title: Implement exact read tools and durable query/deadline control
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Host workflow state in the approved repository; durable stage ownership rather than new orchestration infrastructure.
steps: Provide authorized list/get evidence tools for pinned complete available scope.
Persist original deadline, stage claims, read/model/token budgets and request identity.
On disconnect/crash/cancel, stop new claims conditionally; reconcile ambiguous work without redispatching blindly.
done_when: Reconnect never resets elapsed time or grants a fresh model budget.
Already-claimed remote work remains potentially chargeable after cancellation.
Busy/oversize/degraded outcomes are explicit; no hidden queue or implicit inference retries.
risk: Local cancellation cannot guarantee an already-authorized provider send did not occur.

title: Render the evidence case with authorized cache, fallback and drill-down
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: CLI/portable HTML backed by shared case records; existing visual style if a UI is built.
steps: Render fixed verdict/rule/formula/source/gap/delivery blocks plus validated cited explanation.
Key cache by permission scope, exact source and accepted revisions and all relevant versions; reauthorize retrieval/publication/export.
Support deterministic degraded fresh-analysis output and successful requested replay/recheck; expose bidirectional source links safely.
done_when: A source/reference click resolves the exact authorized captured revision.
Model outage cannot change deterministic control arithmetic or masquerade as complete fresh model analysis.
Old prose cannot be attached to new numbers after a correction.
risk: Cached sensitive content or stale citations can bypass current permissions or invalidate proof.

title: Capture the first C16 pass/breach pair, then extend per control
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Actual workshop scenario controls or explicitly organizer-accepted replay/test mechanisms; no unauthorized fault injection.
steps: Declare permitted scenario/run/window membership and provenance before execution; immediately capture a real or organizer-accepted C16 pass/breach pair once T19 is ready, without waiting for C7, C9 or the optional UI.
Extend the same runner with C7 named cases after T22 and C9 named windows after T24; record separate per-control milestone status rather than one all-or-nothing completion checkbox.
Attach actual ServiceNow delivery proof after T26 and a model-assisted case after T34 as separate end-to-end milestones; these enrich the already captured evidence.
Save expected outcomes, exact real identifiers and sources. Keep synthetic arithmetic fixtures separately labelled.
done_when: The initial C16 milestone has named reproducible pass and genuine or organizer-accepted breach evidence with dated rules and actual identifiers.
Each later claimed completed control has its own independently checked pass/breach milestone; unfinished C7/C9 evidence cannot be concealed by the C16 result.
Governance and model-assisted integration milestones have separate actual evidence before those integration claims are made.
Simulation/replay is not presented as a live platform fault without organizer acceptance.
risk: Safe live breach generation may require organizer-supported modes; invented failures do not satisfy completion.

title: Run the focused adversarial campaign across all required paths
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Local fault fixtures plus only permitted live failure modes through the existing package.
steps: Test missing streams/windows, duplicates, changed IDs, correction races and stale policy/cache.
Test injection, forged cross-scope links, wrong-meaning citations, model truncation/timeout and source permission change.
Test ambiguous ServiceNow write, stale operation, response visibility gap and restart recovery; optional admission tests run only if bonus implemented.
done_when: Critical false VERIFIED links and unsupported numeric/verdict assertions are rejected.
Known breaches survive unrelated missing evidence.
Every observed defect has a correction/retest or a clearly scoped unresolved gap.
risk: A happy-path demo can conceal the exact failures judges ask about.

title: Build the C16 offline rechecker first, then extend C7/C9
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Small separate reference implementation consuming exported accepted records; no model, live source or cloud dependency.
steps: Implement independent C16 execution-dedup/accounting arithmetic first and run it on hand-checked fixtures immediately after T19; exercise actual named captures as the first T35 milestone arrives.
Extend the same checker to C7 expected coverage/pairs after T22 and C9 relative drop/allowance after T24; track each supported control separately.
Do not import production evaluator functions. Consume explicit accepted input manifests and preserve missing-evidence states.
Compare exact calculations with hand-checked boundary/duplicate/correction fixtures and then named captured cases.
done_when: C16 accepted inputs can be independently recomputed before the other control evaluators are finished.
Every control claimed in a later package has its own passing reference-checker milestone; unsupported controls remain explicitly unsupported.
Changing an accepted input produces an explained result difference.
The report states that arithmetic agreement does not certify upstream truth.
risk: A wrapper around the main evaluator is not an independent recomputation.

title: Evaluate extraction/link quality and model contribution
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Fixed held-out labelled evidence set and actual approved model profile; compare against structured retrieval/template baseline.
steps: Freeze positive, negative, ambiguous, contradictory and injection cases not used to tune the final prompt.
Measure field/span correctness, verified-link precision, missed/unresolved links and unsupported assertions.
Compare validated coverage, latency/cost and navigation effort with and without Nemotron; report observed results only.
done_when: Critical suite has zero false VERIFIED cross-team/cross-run links and zero unsupported numeric/verdict assertions before release.
All counts, sample sizes and failures are reported.
Claimed model value is supported by the comparison, or its role is narrowed.
risk: Small hackathon tests do not establish universal accuracy or production safety.

title: Benchmark full analysis, freshness, degraded behavior and costs
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Measured real approved model and source route; local replay timings labelled separately.
steps: Freeze at least20 held-out bounded scopes and repeat trials including missing/conflicting cases and size limits.
Measure arrival-to-publication, data-ready full analysis, source-to-index freshness, cold/warm/concurrent behavior and usage separately.
Report median/p95/max, sample count and complete-analysis rate; count unexpected fallbacks/errors as full-analysis failures.
done_when: Official answer-and-records target of two minutes is rehearsed; own60-second full-analysis target is claimed only within the measured envelope.
At most1run or1window<=20runs,2000required structured records,20excerpts<=18000chars and verified model token caps are disclosed for the proposed profile.
Deliberate outage success is reported as correct degradation, not successful full Nemotron analysis.
risk: Fast partial or cached answers cannot substantiate a fresh full-analysis latency claim.

title: Export the portable six-artifact bundle and rebuild local indexes
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: JSONL/JSON, dated documentation, packaged CLI/reference checker, local SQLite and portable diagram/HTML; no live network required for critical replay inputs.
steps: After T49 resolves the permitted export boundary, export approved team-authored evidence and accepted/proposed/assessment/case/source manifests with exact locally resolvable permitted critical inputs; do not bulk-copy AWS lab source/data by default.
Package thresholds, runnable query, named cases, actual one-page architecture and gaps as six clearly indexed artifacts.
Rebuild exact local indexes from exports and exercise recorded-case inspection and offline recomputation in a clean directory.

Produce a first C16-only bundle as soon as its case/query/rechecker/governance/model milestones are ready; extend it with completed C7/C9 milestones later. Label unfinished controls explicitly rather than waiting to exercise packaging until all three are done.
done_when: Every critical reference resolves inside the bundle.
Query/install instructions and package versions are included.
Snapshot/as-of limits, protected-field redaction and inability to learn later remote revocations are disclosed.
Every packaged source/data class is covered by the verified submission/export permission; unsupported export scope remains blocked and visible.
The first supported-control bundle is replayable before expanding scope; final contents never imply unimplemented controls are complete.
risk: AWS-provided materials may be restricted to the workshop account. Unresolved permission cannot be treated as an authorized export; external-only links or hidden dependencies also threaten reproducibility.

title: Validate release completeness and scope the final architecture honestly
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Local manifest validator and manual cross-review against workshop rules; no additional platform.
steps: Check all six artifacts, dated rules, capability evidence, actual model proof, ServiceNow proof and pass/breach cases.
Mark each control complete only when declared mechanism, measurements, named cases, query/recheck and export are present.
Redraw the one-page architecture to show implemented versus conditional/unavailable pieces and list consequential gaps.
done_when: Completion score is an evidence-backed0–3 count, separate from pass rate or a subjective winning assessment.
Unimplemented optional features are absent from actual-operation claims.
Mandatory integration/model requirements are either demonstrated or explicitly unresolved.
risk: A polished design score must not be represented as percent implemented or probability of winning.

title: Rehearse the judge flow from a clean start
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Packaged CLI/optional UI and exported bundle; actual approved live route only for the explicitly labelled fresh demo.
steps: Alternate roles: one person selects unfamiliar scope/questions, the other opens exact evidence and explains formula/authority/limitations.
Demonstrate normal fresh analysis, a rejected false relation and deterministic model-outage behavior.
Time answer plus supporting records, record failures and re-run only affected fixes.
done_when: Both participants can explain enforcement point, control, evidence binding, owner delivery and uncertainty.
Selected supported scopes meet the official timing requirement or the failure is disclosed.
Demo does not depend on a preselected cached answer being passed off as fresh.
risk: One rehearsed happy path may fail when judges choose different scope.

title: Add a second observation point or generic callback only if useful
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Gateway B preferred if permitted; alternatively one declared tool boundary or authenticated read-only source. Generic callback optional.
steps: Choose exactly one supported additional boundary based on evidence benefit and available time.
Reuse canonical contracts/control logic; authenticate/correlate any callback and retain duplicate safety.
Demonstrate portability with clear observation versus enforcement labels.
done_when: Additional boundary contributes actual scoped records without a forked control engine.
Unimplemented alternative adapters are explicitly deferred.
Callback sender identity is not confused with proof of an actual human decision.
risk: Attempting every possible boundary can delay all completed controls.

title: Gate optional inline admission on provable bounds and bypass coverage
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Verified blocking model hook plus permitted atomic shared state; no strict prevention claim on telemetry-only access.
steps: Verify every reachable model route, hidden retry and all counted input/output/reasoning usage can be conservatively bounded.
Define synchronous evaluate contract and unsupported/error behavior.
Stop this bonus if bypass, bound, finality or atomicity cannot be proved; retain completed accounting.
done_when: Aggregate bound covers all permitted executions and the actual hook can prevent dispatch.
Contract differentiates per-control results from overall admission.
Unverified assumptions are visible; a post-run detector is not called strict prevention.
risk: An input estimate or output cap alone is not an upper bound on all billable executions.

title: Implement atomic optional admission and dispatch ownership
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Permitted transactional/conditional-write store, proposed DynamoDB if verified; minimal durable transition journal.
steps: Reserve before ALLOW using finally settled actual F plus all unresolved full bounds H plus requested bound B<=cap.
Reuse exact transport duplicate attempts and reject changed content under reused identities.
Conditionally claim one dispatch owner against run/policy state; durably journal transitions before action.
done_when: Concurrent requests cannot exceed the declared exposure bound under tested assumptions.
Crash/ambiguous dispatch retains liability and cannot blindly retry.
One local dispatch claim is never described as exactly-once provider execution.
risk: Atomic local claims do not fence a provider unless the remote interface supports the required semantics.

title: Implement optional settlement, cancellation and uncertain-outcome recovery
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Same permitted shared state; provider finality/no-upward-liability evidence required before release.
steps: Release cancellation only after conditional proof dispatch could not be claimed.
Retain full bounds across provisional usage and unknown outcomes; settle only complete execution sets with verified final usage.
Stop new claims on closure/revocation and halt admission on accepted bound violation/upward-final correction; preserve historical liabilities.
done_when: Provisional usage never prematurely frees capacity.
Already-claimed work may still physically send after closure and remains accounted.
Without finality evidence, the bound stays reserved for the run instead of being guessed away.
risk: Later provider correction can reveal an assumption failure; already spent tokens cannot be undone.

title: Add background extraction or natural-language scope planning only after core proof
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Same approved Nemotron route and shared workers; no new agent platform.
steps: Profile whether pre-extracting notes improves measured latency/cost; deduplicate with explicit budgets and generated-text exclusions.
Optionally translate natural-language questions into proposed explicit scopes requiring host validation.
Retain explicit-selector baseline and prevent automatic investigation recursion.
done_when: Background work is separately accounted and does not count as a fresh query model call.
Ambiguous scope is surfaced rather than silently narrowed.
Optional feature demonstrates a measured benefit without reducing control completion.
risk: Natural-language planning can select a favorable subset or create hidden unbounded work.

title: Profile additional NVIDIA model tiers only for an evidenced need
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: Workshop-approved Super, Nano Omni or Ultra only if actually available; names are preferred roles, not verified model IDs.
steps: Use Super only as a profiled replacement composer or separately timed investigation.
Use Omni only when real authorized media evidence needs region/time-referenced extraction.
Use Ultra only for separately budgeted offline complex/adversarial work; do not chain all tiers into the core deadline.
done_when: Each retained tier has actual execution proof and measured value over the core profile.
Media extractions remain proposals subject to source/span/scope validation.
Unavailable/unhelpful tiers are explicitly deferred with no new deployment.
risk: Adding models for branding can dilute the working submission and exceed latency/cost limits.

title: Resolve export/submission permissions and confirm the actual deadline
technology: PROPOSED / CONDITIONAL: workshop review/join terms, official submission instructions and organizer clarification through a user-authorized channel; no external message is sent by this task plan.
steps: Capture a minimal source-cited capability/gap register with unknowns, owners, required checks and consequences; preserve documented versus exercised status.

Reconcile the displayed restriction on using AWS-provided materials outside the account with slide requirements for an evidence submission. Distinguish team-authored code/reports, approved exported evidence, lab source code, recordings and supplied data.

Prepare the exact clarification needed from organizers and obtain an answer through a permitted user-authorized route before restricted material is copied; do not infer permission from the existence of an export requirement.

Confirm submission cutoff, timezone, upload format and environment expiry separately. The displayed Oct4 2026 09:00 AM start has no visible timezone and a72-hour environment duration is not a confirmed submission deadline.
done_when: An authoritative documented rule or organizer answer defines the allowed export/submission classes and destinations, with unresolved classes blocked.
A team-authored/approved-evidence packaging path is feasible; any critical evidence that cannot leave the account has an explicit accepted alternative or release gap.
Actual submission cutoff and timezone are recorded independently of account lifetime; no invented deadline is used.
No organizer message is sent without explicit user authorization.
risk: Submission requirements and account-material restrictions may conflict in scope; exporting by assumption or treating environment duration as the deadline can invalidate the submission.
